sites.name: Rent the Runway headquarters
sites.description: About 71,000 square feet under a lease to November 2032, of which about 47,000 square feet is subleased.

source.label: Rent the Runway Form 10-K for fiscal year ended January 31, 2025
source.quote: Our corporate headquarters is located in Brooklyn, New York under a lease that expires in November 2032. This lease consists of approximately 71,000 square feet of space, of which we sublease approximately 47,000 square feet to other parties.

sites.name: Secaucus fulfillment center
sites.description: One of two leased fulfillment centers; most employees work in the New Jersey and Texas fulfillment centers.

source.label: Rent the Runway Form 10-K for fiscal year ended January 31, 2025
source.quote: We also lease and operate two fulfillment centers in Secaucus, New Jersey and Arlington, Texas under leases that expire in August 2029 and May 2030, respectively.
